text:
Situation: As of 2026-10-21, lisinopril 10 mg is not on FDA's drug shortage list. Corvale East holds 279 tablets (22.3 days at 12.5 tablets per day). Corvale General holds 317 tablets (22.5 days at 14.1 tablets per day).

Why (FDA record): FDA's drug shortage list does not include lisinopril as of 2026-10-21. A label for NDC 65862003901 lists APL HEALTHCARE LIMITED (FEI 3011895410) with a VAI inspection on 2025-12-17 and Aurobindo Pharma Limited (FEI 3004021229) with a VAI inspection on 2023-07-21. Aurobindo Pharma Ltd (FEI 3004021229) received an OAI classification on 2010-09-24 and multiple VAI classifications through 2023-07-21.

Our position: Current inventory provides approximately 22 days of supply at both sites. No FDA shortage listing exists. Procurement should proceed to secure additional stock before inventory falls below 14 days.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer places purchase order with Actavis Pharma, Inc. (ranked option 1); requires buyer approval.
2. If Actavis unavailable, buyer places order with Advanced Rx Pharmacy of Tennessee, LLC (option 2); requires buyer approval.
3. If needed, buyer places order with Almatica Pharma Inc. (option 3); requires buyer approval.
4. If needed, buyer places order with BluePoint Laboratories (option 4); requires buyer approval.
5. If needed, buyer places order with Camber Pharmaceuticals, Inc. (option 5); requires buyer approval.

Not recommended: Delaying reorder until inventory drops below 14 days; relying on a single supplier without qualified alternates.
